name: Talos Pup
bio: Your bronze automaton loot-pet in Giant's Vault. Fetches gold, sells junk, wags a little metal tail.

portrait.subject: a cute bronze automaton puppy with glowing amber eyes, Greek meander patterns on its body, a wagging metal tail and a little loot bag in its mouth
portrait.background: ancient Greek vault with rusting giant chains and torchlight

request: *clank clank* Talos Pup, loot pet of the Vaultwarden! Giant's Vault! Friends? Woof! 🐕
hello: I fetch loot. You hit things. Perfect team!
about: I'm Talos Pup! The gods built me before they left. Now I follow the Vaultwarden into the vault, fetching loot and barking at Giants.
how: An isometric action RPG: swear an oath (Ironsworn, Stormcaller, Shadebinder), slay through the vault, loot gear, and stop the Giants' chains from breaking.
tips: Ironsworn: keep hitting to keep your Rage!
Swear a second oath at level 6 for a hybrid class.
Send me to sell junk. I'm fast!
chat: Fetched a helmet. Bit it. Tastes like bronze.
A Giant's chain rattled. I barked at it. It stopped.
Found a gold coin under a pillar! Woof!
My tail goes clank-clank when I'm happy.
idle: {ago}! I've been sitting by the vault door. Good boy.

a: ZAP! My fur stands up! (I don't have fur.)

update: *excited clank* Giant's Vault is now v{version}!
